name: Back to Back [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your ally’s eyes are your own, and yours are his.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): While your ally is flanked and adjacent to you, your ally receives a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against attacks from opponents flanking them.

Polymorph: Spiritual Ally, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: G. Tyler Ernst.
